description: Product Name: Power BI Baidu ECharts Advanced Dashboard Visualization Object Version: 1.0.0 Release date: December 2, 2024 Developer: [Infortime Shiqin] Main functions: 1. Data driven visualization: Users can directly drive dashboard charts through Power BI's data model to achieve dynamic data display. 2. Highly customizable: Provides multiple customization options, including color, font, chart type, layout, etc., to meet the display needs of different users. 3. Interactivity: Supports interactive operations such as mouse hovering and clicking, enhancing user experience. 4. Responsive design: The dashboard can adapt to different display devices and resolutions. 5. Multi language support: Supports multiple languages to meet the needs of global users. Usage scenario: -Business monitoring: Real time monitoring of key business indicators such as sales, user growth, conversion rates, etc. -Performance analysis: Analyze the performance of different products or services, identify advantages and improvement points. -Resource management: Display resource allocation and usage, optimize resource allocation. -Risk control: Monitor potential risks and issues, and take timely measures. This visualization object aims to provide Power BI users with an innovative and feature rich way of presenting data, helping them better understand and analyze business data.
